article.headline: Weems and Nevada win 96-95 in OT against Saint Mary's
article.description: — Vaughn Weems scored 33 points and Styles Phipps had 11 of his 25 in overtime as Nevada took down Saint Mary's 96-95 on Sunday.
article.linkText: Weems and Nevada win 96-95 in OT against Saint Mary's

keywords: Saint Mary's Gaels @ Nevada Wolf Pack
article.story: STATELINE, Nev. -- — Vaughn Weems scored 33 points and Styles Phipps had 11 of his 25 in overtime as Nevada took down Saint Mary's 96-95 on Sunday. Weems also added five rebounds and three steals for the Wolf Pack (2-0). Phipps shot 10 of 12 from the field and 4 for 6 from the line while he also had five assists. Elijah Price shot 4 of 11 from the field and 3 for 5 from the line to finish with 11 points. Joshua Dent finished with 30 points, five assists and two steals for the Gaels (2-1). Saint Mary's also got 24 points, eight rebounds and four assists from Mantas Juzenas. Jeremy Dent-Smith finished with 20 points and three steals. Up next Nevada's next game is Wednesday against UCSB on the road. Saint Mary's hosts UIC on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
